spans:
name = "dotnet-pal-standalone"
description = "Repository qualification configurations (not a consumer library)"
include = ["src/**", "Cargo.toml", "README.md", "LICENSE", "native/**"]
publish = false


[features]

# No backend by default: a library consumer declares its own port with
# `define_pal!`. The features below assemble standalone static libraries.
default = []
linux = ["dep:dotnet-pal-linux"]
# Virtual memory from an immutable C host table (dotnet_pal_host_v2).
host = ["dep:dotnet-pal-host"]
# Additional C host tables. Each requires its provider symbol before startup.
host-services = ["host", "dotnet-pal-host/host-services"]
host-kernel = ["host-services", "dotnet-pal-host/host-kernel"]
host-runtime = ["host-kernel", "dotnet-pal-host/host-runtime"]
host-context = ["host-runtime", "dotnet-pal-host/host-context"]
host-support = ["host", "dotnet-pal-host/host-support"]
host-topology = ["host", "dotnet-pal-host/host-topology"]
host-process = ["host", "dotnet-pal-host/host-process"]
host-image = ["host", "dotnet-pal-host/host-image"]
host-streams = ["host", "dotnet-pal-host/host-streams"]
host-files = ["host", "dotnet-pal-host/host-files"]
host-sockets = ["host", "dotnet-pal-host/host-sockets"]
host-faults = ["host", "dotnet-pal-host/host-faults"]
host-system = ["host", "dotnet-pal-host/host-system"]
host-notifications = ["host", "dotnet-pal-host/host-notifications"]
host-processes = ["host", "dotnet-pal-host/host-processes"]
host-terminal = ["host", "dotnet-pal-host/host-terminal"]
host-watches = ["host", "dotnet-pal-host/host-watches"]
host-mappings = ["host", "dotnet-pal-host/host-mappings"]
host-volumes = ["host", "dotnet-pal-host/host-volumes"]
host-network = ["host", "dotnet-pal-host/host-network"]
host-local-sockets = ["host", "dotnet-pal-host/host-local-sockets"]
host-accounts = ["host", "dotnet-pal-host/host-accounts"]
host-priority = ["host", "dotnet-pal-host/host-priority"]
host-packets = ["host", "dotnet-pal-host/host-packets"]
host-spawn-as = ["host", "dotnet-pal-host/host-spawn-as"]
# OS-independent storage providers usable by any port.
storage-arena = ["dotnet-pal-storage/storage-arena"]
storage-hooks = ["dotnet-pal-storage/storage-hooks"]
storage-grow = ["dep:dotnet-pal-wasm"]
# Standalone linear-storage libraries: the bounded static arena, the embedder
# hooks (sharing the C heap on WASI), or wasm32 memory.grow for modules with no
# other allocator.
linear = ["storage-arena", "dep:dotnet-pal-storage"]
linear-heap = ["linear", "storage-hooks"]
linear-grow = ["linear", "storage-grow"]
# Storage budget selection for managed experiments; the default stays 8 MiB.
# These only change the capacity constant and select no backend by themselves.
linear-gc = ["dotnet-pal-storage/linear-gc"]
# 64 MiB budget for managed OOM qualification; not GCHeapHardLimit (64-bit only).
linear-gc-small = ["linear-gc", "dotnet-pal-storage/linear-gc-small"]
# WASI Preview 1 providers on wasm32-wasip1.
wasi-clock = ["linear", "dep:dotnet-pal-wasip1"]
wasi-runtime = ["wasi-clock"]
wasi-dispatch = ["wasi-runtime", "dotnet-pal-wasip1/wasi-dispatch"]

dotnet-pal-rs = { path = "../.." }
dotnet-pal-linux = { path = "../../crates/dotnet-pal-linux", optional = true }
dotnet-pal-host = { path = "../../crates/dotnet-pal-host", optional = true }
dotnet-pal-storage = { path = "../../crates/dotnet-pal-storage", optional = true }
dotnet-pal-wasm = { path = "../../crates/dotnet-pal-wasm", optional = true }
dotnet-pal-wasip1 = { path = "../../crates/dotnet-pal-wasip1", optional = true }
